note:
BH-5944: how long `fleet-status-push.sh --dispatch` waits (1 s steps) for every fleet project's own run to write state/fleet-status-push/

/row.json (v 1, at >= the dispatch start). A row still missing or late at the limit is computed by the dispatch itself, so the push always carries every project. 0 = no wait: the dispatch computes every row itself at once. Not a whole number is 60, with one log line.
